reviews.review:
This game needs some serious polish......  Mostly the art, tutorial, and UI implementation.

Let's start with the game art. The artist who created this game stated in the description, "As a solo developer with limited capabilities, some artwork uses AI-generated initial drafts that have been further adjusted and modified." I understand, but some pixel art pieces are visibly hand-drawn with care. Some easily made things, like side decorations, which could be done in 10 minutes or so uses AI, this thing is almost the whole game. It is mostly unnecessary, such a vibe killer! Also, please use a consistent palette, theme; it looks a bit ugly 
The game design:
Obviously,  the creator didn't playtest this game with another person. For example, what I mean, in the tutorial area, the devilman?, the devilman says something like this: "Hey, do you see that dice to your right?" The fact that nothing on the screen looked like dice left me confused, so I looked at the trailer to see how the game plays. The dice had a devilman face cover, so it looked like it was a decoration. The tutorial didn't explained EVERYTHING (mostly); I didn't know you could use Items, why the buffs were at the start round, and you could drag the dice into the slots, and even what the objective was,
not knowing everything, I can't say it is a good game that has a great game loop, nor can I say the opposite.
Also badly translated chinese.

Said enough, if you want it, you can get it. This game seems interesting, honestly. This game, without a doubt, is worth 1 Eur
